purpose: Execute the atomic create-reference-plane operation within the MA-02 boundary: One geometry-reference plane only. It does not create or attach a persistent DatumPlane.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires create-reference-plane and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: frame
inputs.description: A valid in-memory frame reference supplied by the caller.

preconditions: frame is a valid Geometry.Frame reference.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: An in-memory plane reference returned by Plane.Create.

postconditions: Plane.Create(frame) returns a plane reference without an exception.
